text:
Ivy Park: Heads-up 00% chance Aurora wants a migration POC this week to validate compat with their vendor (POST /v1/generate + chunked streaming).
Noah Kim: What are their must-haves?
Ivy Park: They need identical chunk boundaries, header passthrough (X-Customer-ID), stop-token semantics, and a short pricing bridge. Also want KMS/HSM details for compliance.
Asha Rao: We can do a lightweight shim: proxy /v1/generate -> /redwood/stream, copy X-Customer-ID into metadata, and re-chunk to match their sample boundaries.
Asha Rao: Quick pseudo-shim: 
```js
// proxy to emulate vendor chunking
app.post('/v1/generate', async (req,res)=>{
  const meta = req.headers['x-customer-id'];
  const s = redwood.stream({input: req.body.prompt, metadata:{customer:meta}});
  for await (const chunk of s) { res.write(formatChunk(chunk)); res.flush(); }
});
```
Noah Kim: Tokenization drift will affect billing. Can we run a 200-sample tokenization + output parity check focusing on HTML and stop-token edges?
Asha Rao: Yes. I'll kick off the parity harness and include a small normalization step (strip-excess-whitespace + deterministic stop flush).
Ivy Park: Security asks: HSM import, SOC2 attestation, subprocessor list, and encryption-for-cached-prefixes.
sec-bot: Auto: "HSM available on Dedicated/Private (lead time 5 business days). KMS + key-wrap supported. SOC2 report available via legal portal."
Noah Kim: Commercial ask from Aurora: 30% off hosted for 30 days + $5k migration credit if they sign Dedicated LOI in 60 days. POC cap $1,000.
Ivy Park: Sales proposal looks okay; finance check pending. Also propose a 48h Dedicated smoke window to prove p95 stability.
infra-bot: Ops checklist: 1) 200 concurrent short requests (<=32 tokens) measure p99; 2) 50 streaming clients for 20s; 3) parity harness run. Requesting SRE window now.
Asha Rao: Early parity sample (50 prompts): 40 exact, 7 minor punctuation diffs, 3 stop-token edge cases. Will upload full diffs by EOD and include failing prompts.
Noah Kim: Action items:
- Asha: full parity diffs + failing prompts by EOD (1769040000)
- Ivy: schedule kickoff and attach SOW + security checklist
- Noah: draft commercial terms & POC cap line for finance
Ivy Park: Kickoff tentatively tomorrow 11am PT. If any blockers, flag here and Ill escalate. :thumbsup:
